recognize_zh: 臨床照片：背部與肩頸有多條線狀、交錯的色素沉著條紋，外觀像鞭痕（flagellate pigmentation），符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭痕狀皮疹。
features: Multiple linear and curvilinear hyperpigmented streaks over the upper back, shoulders and posterior neck
Criss-crossing whip-like (flagellate) pattern, most confluent over the upper back
Streaks follow scratch-like distribution rather than dermatomes
No vesicles, ulceration or scaling evident at this resolution
Alopecia of the scalp consistent with chemotherapy exposure
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the patient's back shows numerous linear and criss-crossing hyperpigmented streaks, most prominent over the upper back and shoulders and extending onto the neck, in a whip-mark (flagellate) pattern. No blistering, ulceration or scale is evident at this resolution, and scalp hair loss is present. In a patient receiving bleomycin, the appearance is consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis/hyperpigmentation.

ddx.vs: Shiitake dermatitis produces a similar pruritic flagellate eruption but follows ingestion of raw or undercooked shiitake mushrooms without bleomycin exposure.
Dermatomyositis shows erythematous rather than purely pigmented streaks, with heliotrope rash, Gottron papules and proximal muscle weakness.
Traumatic whip marks show fresh bruising, abrasions or healing scars in a pattern matched to history, rather than pruritus-related pigmentation after chemotherapy.
Phytophotodermatitis produces streaky hyperpigmentation on sun-exposed areas after contact with plant furocoumarins and sunlight.
